node: AI server MLCC upstream dielectric powders
summary: Layer 1B expansion found very few US-exchange-listed pure plays in high-end barium titanate dielectric powders. The most direct public exposure is mostly via non-US companies with US OTC ADR access or via US-listed specialty passive-component makers that consume MLCC ceramic dielectrics rather than produce merchant BaTiO3 powder. Reference lane anchors are Murata and TDK because they are obvious MLCC leaders with visible AI/data-center MLCC relevance. Underfollowed lane candidates are Vishay and Knowles: both are US-listed, smaller than the Japanese reference leaders, and make MLCC/ceramic capacitor products, but their exposure to sub-100nm BaTiO3 powder tightness is an inference that needs customer, sourcing, margin, and product-mix verification.
